Using AI for defensive advantage¶ The administration’s post-Mythos strategy centered on a cyber window of opportunity. The White House believed that American companies and agencies could leverage advanced AI tools to fix as many software vulnerabilities as possible before adversaries acquired and weaponized similar capabilities.
